parameters.content:
## 🎯 Califnco Instagram Daily Post Workflow

**Hugging Face FLUX AI Pipeline:**
1. ⏰ **Daily 10 AM IST Trigger**
2. 📄 **Read Product from Google Sheets** (Sheet: `Products`)
3. 🎯 **Select Product for Today** (Picks 1 product/day)
4. 🤖 **Generate AI Caption (Gemini 3.5 Flash)** (Super fast ~2s)
5. 🎨 **Generate AI Banner (Hugging Face FLUX)** (Native `this.helpers.httpRequest` — generates banner & uploads to ImgBB)
6. 🔗 **Merge Caption + Banner URL**
7. 📦 **Instagram: Create Media Container** (`graph.instagram.com`)
8. 💾 **Save Container ID**
9. ⏳ **Wait 5s**
10. 🚀 **Instagram: Publish Post**
11. 📝 **Log Success to Google Sheets** (`PublishLog`)
